job_title: Head of Data Science & AI Engineering
description: Title:Head of Data Science & AI Engineering Company:Ipsen Bioscience, Inc. About Ipsen: Ipsen is a mid-sized global biopharmaceutical company with a focus on transformative medicines in three therapeutic areas: Oncology, Rare Disease and Neuroscience. Supported by nearly 100 years of development experience, with global hubs in the U.S., France and the U.K, we tackle areas of high unmet medical need through research and innovation. Our passionate teams in more than 40 countries are focused on what matters and endeavor every day to bring medicines to patients in 88 countries. We build a workplace that champions human-centric leadership and fosters a culture of collaboration, excellence and impact. At Ipsen, every individual is empowered to be their true selves, grow and thrive alongside the company’s success. Join us on our journey towards sustainable growth, creating real impact on patients and society! For more information, visit us at https://www.ipsen.com/ and follow our latest news on LinkedIn and Instagram. Job Description: Summary The Head of Data Science & AI Engineering is a pivotal role within the Global Data & AI Department. This position acts as a leader and strategist, responsible for developing and governing the technical strategy and the capabilities for enterprise advanced analytics and AI that enable Ipsen's Business Data & AI Strategy. The Head of Data Science & AI Engineering fosters deep partnerships with business domains, provides technical leadership for data/AI initiatives, and oversees the entire lifecycle of data and AI products, including the development of internal products and the adoption of third-party off-the-shelf AI solutions. Additionally, this position champions the Data Science & AI Center of Excellence, mentors a team of data scientists, data engineers, and AI engineers, and drives the adoption of new tools and technologies to enhance the team's capabilities. Effective communication with business leaders and stakeholders, as well as ensuring compliance with internal policies and relevant regulations, are also key responsibilities of this role. The Global Digital IT (GDIT) division is dedicated to being the business partner of choice for digital, data, and technologies, delivering outstanding value at speed and scale for patients and Ipsen. In this transformative context, GDIT plays a crucial role in driving innovation and efficiency across the organization. The Global Data & AI Division within GDIT was established to enhance Ipsen's Data and AI capabilities and serve as a key business enabler. This central Hub for Data, Analytics, and AI unites diverse expertise to foster collaboration and deliver value throughout the data lifecycle. The division is structured around six core functions (Data & AI Strategy, Product & Delivery Management, Data Science & AI Engineering, Data Integration & Analytics, Data Governance & Data Management, Platform Engineering) to ensure the comprehensive delivery of data and AI initiatives while maintaining strong, scalable data governance and foundations. Main Responsibilities Design, implement and govern the technical strategy for enterprise advanced analytics and AI, ensuring robust and scalable capabilities, standards, methodologies, and best practices that enable Ipsen's Business Data & AI Strategy. Ensure this technical strategy adheres to Ipsen's internal policies and external regulatory requirements. Be a key contributor of the overall enterprise AI strategy, in collaboration with GDIT and with the business Foster deep partnerships with business domains to understand their needs, explore new opportunities, and deliver data/AI solutions that drive business value. Provide technical leadership for advanced analytics and AI initiatives. Oversee the entire development lifecycle of data and AI products, from feasibility to MVP development, scaling, and maintenance, either through direct involvement or by providing supervision and guidance. Ensure adherence to best practices in AI and data science, maintaining high-quality delivery, reliability, and performance throughout all stages of the product lifecycle. Oversee and ensure the integration of data & AI models into existing systems and seamless deployment and monitoring of AI models in production environments. Conduct comprehensive assessments and evaluations of third-party AI solutions, considering technical performance, regulatory compliance, security standards, and alignment with Ipsen's strategic objectives. Ensure that selected solutions meet the highest standards of quality, reliability, and ethical practices. Support the adoption across Ipsen of the third-party AI solutions, such as enterprise productivity solutions, to enhance operational efficiency and innovation. Develop and implement metrics to monitor the performance and impact of AI and data science initiatives. Regularly report on the progress and outcomes of projects to senior leadership and stakeholders. Lead the Data Science & AI Center of Excellence, acculturating the Global Digital, IT teams, and the Business Functions, while fostering and animating the Data Science & AI engineering community across Ipsen. Effectively communicate the outcomes of initiatives and complex AI concepts to Ipsen business leaders, as well as other internal and external audiences, in a clear, engaging, and actionable manner. Ensure that these communications drive understanding, foster collaboration, and highlight the strategic value of AI. Lead and mentor a team of data scientists, data engineers and AI engineers, fostering a culture of innovation and continuous improvement. Drive the adoption of new tools and technologies to enhance the team's capabilities. Promote a culture of innovation by encouraging the exploration of new technologies and methodologies. Stay updated with the latest advancements in AI and data science technologies and methodologies. Lead research initiatives to explore cutting-edge AI and data science techniques and their potential applications. Collaborate with cross-functional teams (business partners, data delivery leads, data managers, platform engineers, etc.) to drive successful implementation of the data & AI products. Ensure efficient allocation of the data & AI resources involved in the initiatives. Manage the relationship with vendors and oversee procurement activities to support the strategic goals of the Data Science & AI activities. Ensure compliance with relevant regulations (e.g., AI Act) and standards, maintaining the integrity and ethical standards of AI and data science initiatives, in collaboration with the Legal, Data Privacy, Quality & Security teams. Knowledge, abilities & experience Advanced degree (Master's or Ph.D.) in Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field. Minimum of 10 years of experience in data science, AI, or related fields, with at least 5 years in a leadership role. Proven track record of leading and managing data science and AI teams, ideally in the pharmaceutical or healthcare industry. Extensive experience in developing and implementing AI and advanced analytics solutions, including internal product development and third-party AI solutions. Strong background in regulatory compliance, data privacy, and security standards relevant to the pharmaceutical industry Strong leadership, drive, and strategic thinking Excellent communication skills Strong interpersonal and facilitation skills to drive alignment and engagement with the partners/stakeholders Possess the ability to work in a matrix organization Foster a culture of innovation Possess the ability to develop and coach talents Ensure accountability for high-quality delivery Possess a business-centric and value-driven approach. Possess an agile mindset with the ability to adapt to changing environments. Be a team player with a growth mindset. Be open-minded and comfortable with change Key Technical Competencies Required Expert in Data Science, Data Engineering and AI, including Machine Learning, Deep Learning, NLP, Generative AI, Agentic AI and LLM (Claude, LLaMa, GPT, etc.) Expert in ML/DL development and deployment frameworks (Scikit-learn, PyTorch, MLflow), Experienced in Data Analysis (Pandas), Data Transformation (DBT) and Data Management Experienced in Cloud Data & AI Services from Azure & AWS (S3, Glue, OpenSearch, Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, etc.) and Cloud Data Platforms (Databricks) Experienced in data programming languages (Python, R, SQL) Experienced in Agile methodology and software development lifecycle Skilled with Collaboration Tools, such as JIRA & Confluence Capable in Technical Architecture and Solution Design Capable in Change Management Capable in UX/UI design The annual base salary range for this position is $180,000 - $260,000. This job is eligible to participate in our short-term incentives program. At Ipsen we are proud to offer a comprehensive employee benefits package, including 401(k) with company contributions, group medical, dental and vision coverage, life and disability insurance, short- and long-term disability insurance, as well as flexible spending accounts. Ipsen also provides parental leave, paid time off, a discretionary winter shutdown, well-being allowance, commuter benefits, and much more. The pay range displayed above is the range of base pay compensation within which Ipsen expects to pay for this role at the time of this posting. Individual compensation within this range depends on a variety of factors, including, but not limited to, prior education and experience, job-related knowledge and demonstrated skills We are committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels heard, valued, and supported; where we embrace “The Real Us”. The value we place on different perspectives and experiences drives our commitment to inclusion and equal opportunities. When we include diverse ways of thinking, we make more thoughtful decisions and discover more innovative solutions. Together we strive to better understand the communities we serve. This means we also want to help you perform at your best when applying for a role with us. If you require any adjustments or support during the application process, please let the recruitment team know. This information will be handled with care and will not affect the outcome of your application. Ipsen is an equal opportunity employer that strictly prohibits unlawful discrimination. We recruit, employ, train, compensate, and promote without regard to an individual’s race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin/ancestry, age, mental/physical disability, medical condition, marital status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. At Ipsen, each employee makes a real impact. Our teams are passionate about what they do because they care about making a difference in patients’ lives. We invest in our employees to support life-changing projects that create positive impact for patients and society. Introduce yourself to our recruiters and we'll get in touch if there's a role that seems like a good match. Learn more about careers with us

Job Description
Our Branch Network Modeling team develops advanced analytics and machine learning solutions that inform high-impact decisions across physical location strategy and field workforce effectiveness.

As an Applied AI Modeling Executive Director in Branch Network Modeling team, you lead a team of AI/ML scientists who build advanced geospatial, graph-based, and network optimization models that directly shape Chase's branch network strategy, including where to open, relocate, or reformat branches. You will be the face of your team's models in high-stakes conversations with senior leaders across Real Estate, Finance, and Market Strategy, as well as with Governance and Compliance stakeholders. Your success will be measured not only by the technical sophistication of your models, but by whether those models earn the trust of the business and change how decisions are made.

Job responsibilities

Build and lead a high-performing team of AI/ML scientists focused on geospatial and graph-based AI modeling in support of Chase's branch network — providing development plans, structured growth opportunities, and visibility to senior stakeholders that position your team members for long-term career success. 
Partner with Real Estate, Finance, and Market Strategy stakeholders to understand their decision-making processes, break down silos between technical and business teams, and enable them to draw maximum benefit from AI/ML models. 
Partner closely with Product, Data, and Engineering teams to translate modeling innovations into scalable, production-ready solutions. 
Lead emerging AI talent in research and adoption of cutting-edge AI techniques, ensuring the right balance between methodological rigor, speed to market, and practical business impact. 
Establish best practices for geospatial model development and cloud-native deployment, ensuring compliance with governance and regulatory expectations. 
Oversee rigorous validation, documentation, and monitoring of models, proactively identifying risks and ensuring adherence to internal and external standards while coaching the team to carry these standards into future leadership role
Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills

Advanced degree (master’s or PhD) in a quantitative or spatial discipline such as Computer Science, Statistics, Machine Learning, Operations Research, Applied Mathematics, or Geography, or a related field.
10+ years of  hands-on experience in developing and deploying advanced AI/ML models, with 5+ years in a technical leadership or people management role. 
Documented expertise in one or more of the following: geospatial analytics and spatial statistics, graph neural networks and network science, optimization and operations research, or advanced machine learning methods applied to location strategy or network design problems. 
Exceptional communication skills and high emotional intelligence, with the ability to translate technical complexity into business language and earn stakeholders’ trust. 
Demonstrated leadership in building and mentoring high-performing technical teams. 
Rigorous statistical thinking, including the ability to interrogate a model's assumptions, defend its methodology under scrutiny from quantitative and non-quantitative audiences alike, and anticipate its behavior under different scenarios. 
Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills

Hold a PhD in a relevant discipline.
Experience with geospatial tools and libraries (e.g., GeoPandas, PySAL, H3, Esri/ArcGIS) and/or graph ML frameworks (e.g., PyTorch Geometric, DGL, NetworkX). 
Experience with geospatial data and tooling including, but not limited to: ArcGIS, Carto, Wherobots, or QGIS. 
Experience with facility location problems, trade area modeling, network design, or spatial optimization in retail, logistics, real estate, or financial services. 
Contributions to applied research in geospatial AI, graph ML, network optimization, or spatial statistics, whether through publications in peer-reviewed journals, patents, or industry presentations.  
Background in financial services, consumer banking, or a regulated industry with model risk management expectations. 
Experience managing stakeholder relationships with non-technical senior leaders in functions such as Real Estate, Finance, or Strategy. 
About Us
Chase is a leading financial services firm, helping nearly half of America’s households and small businesses achieve their financial goals through a broad range of financial products. Our mission is to create engaged, lifelong relationships and put our customers at the heart of everything we do. We also help small businesses, nonprofits and cities grow, delivering solutions to solve all their financial needs. 


We offer a competitive total rewards package including base salary determined based on the role, experience, skill set and location. Those in eligible roles may receive commission-based pay and/or discretionary incentive compensation, paid in the form of cash and/or forfeitable equity, awarded in recognition of individual achievements and contributions.  We also offer a range of benefits and programs to meet employee needs, based on eligibility. These benefits include comprehensive health care coverage, on-site health and wellness centers, a retirement savings plan, backup childcare, tuition reimbursement, mental health support, financial coaching and more. Additional details about total compensation and benefits will be provided during the hiring process.

- Replace the LinkedIn-style profile dump with a true executive resume: add a headline such as “Applied AI / ML Executive Director | Geospatial, Graph & Optimization Modeling | Banking Strategy” and a 4-5 line summary aligned to branch network strategy, regulated model deployment, and senior stakeholder influence.
- Add a “Core Competencies” section with ATS keywords from the posting: geospatial modeling, graph analytics, network optimization, location strategy, branch network planning, workforce optimization, applied AI/ML, model governance, model risk, compliance, executive leadership, cross-functional stakeholder management.
- Reframe experience bullets to emphasize business decisions driven by models, not just delivery work; use results such as revenue impact, cost savings, network redesign decisions, forecast accuracy, service expansion, or operational efficiency, with metrics wherever possible.
- Surface any work related to geospatial, routing, network design, satellite imagery, LiDAR, logistics, transportation, or location intelligence near the top of the resume, since that is the closest match to Chase’s branch network modeling scope.
- Strengthen leadership positioning by showing team size, org scope, budget ownership, hiring/coaching, executive presentations, and influence across business, finance, operations, risk, and technology; the role is more “leader of leaders” than individual contributor.
- Add a dedicated “Banking / Regulated Environment” emphasis using your American Express and Anthem experience; explicitly mention governance, controls, explainability, validation, risk management, and building trusted models for business decisions in regulated settings.
- Rewrite vague claims into ATS-friendly accomplishment bullets, for example: “Led 50-100 data scientists delivering $1M-$8M AI programs,” “Built AI solutions adopted by senior stakeholders across US and Germany,” and “Directed 20+ AI PoCs in computer vision/geospatial domains,” instead of broad narrative statements in the About section.
cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Committee,

Chase’s Applied AI Modeling Executive Director role is an especially compelling fit for my background because it sits at the intersection of advanced modeling, executive leadership, and high-stakes business decision-making. The opportunity to shape branch network strategy through geospatial, graph-based, and optimization models is exactly the kind of applied AI challenge I have built my career around—translating sophisticated analytical methods into decisions leaders can trust and act on in complex, regulated environments.

Over the course of 19+ years, I have led AI, machine learning, and data science initiatives across banking, transportation, logistics, manufacturing, aerospace, and other large-scale industries where operational decisions carry significant financial and customer impact. My academic foundation—a PhD and Master’s in Decision Sciences from premier institutions including the Indian Institute of Science—has equipped me to solve deeply quantitative problems, while my industry experience has strengthened my ability to turn those solutions into scalable business outcomes. In banking especially, I have worked at the intersection of analytics, governance, and enterprise execution, where rigor, explainability, and stakeholder confidence are essential.

What I would bring to Chase is a combination of technical depth and leadership range: the ability to guide teams building advanced models, align cross-functional partners around strategic decisions, and ensure strong governance throughout the model lifecycle. My work in scalable AI systems and applied analytics has consistently required balancing innovation with practical adoption—helping senior stakeholders understand not just what a model predicts, but why it matters and how it should inform action. That balance feels central to this role, where modeling directly influences where and how Chase invests in its physical network.

I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my experience can help Chase continue building a best-in-class Branch Network Modeling capability. Thank you for your consideration.

Sincerely,  
**the candidate**
